nodes.label: Architecture — Mandi Price + Weather Data Layer
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for data-layer design; implementation plan defers to it.

nodes.label: Operating rules for Antigravity agent
nodes.rationale: Recon before coding, free only, never invent endpoints, no fake data, phase-gated.

nodes.label: No fake data rule (provenance on every value)
nodes.rationale: Project removed dummy data; no synthetic history, interpolation or silent averaging.

nodes.label: Supabase Free tier constraint (500 MB, 7-day idle pause)
nodes.rationale: Drives scope-filtered ingest, retention jobs and daily keep-alive.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions cron scheduler
nodes.rationale: Vercel Hobby cron is once/day and imprecise, so ingestion runs from GitHub Actions.

nodes.label: Stateless FastAPI read path
nodes.rationale: FastAPI host may be serverless; no in-process schedulers.

nodes.label: P3 One primary + validators, not averaging
nodes.rationale: Averaging biased sources does not produce truth; validators detect disagreement and lower confidence.

nodes.label: Tier A — Advisory coverage (6 crops, pre-ingested, fused weather)
Tier B — Explore coverage (any crop/market, live pass-through)
nodes.rationale: Full national ingest would be ~1.4M rows for 90 days, exhausting 500 MB; Tier B uses live lookup + bounded watch list.

nodes.label: data.gov.in Agmarknet daily feed (priority 100)
nodes.rationale: Official current-day feed; historical queries unreliable; demo key caps at 10 records.

nodes.label: agmarknet PyPI package 0.2.2 (priority 80)
nodes.rationale: Talks to live Agmarknet backend for 0–60 day backfill; new/unofficial so wrapped defensively.

nodes.label: CEDA Agri-Market Data, Ashoka University (priority 50)
nodes.rationale: Deep history 2001→present but refreshed monthly, so not used for recent window.

nodes.label: Kaggle Daily Wholesale Commodity Prices seed (priority 10)
Open-Meteo (PRIMARY weather source)
nodes.rationale: Free, key-less, covers forecast, recent days and ERA5-Land history at finest free resolution.

nodes.label: NASA POWER (validator + agro baselines + fallback)
nodes.rationale: Different modelling lineage (MERRA-2/CERES) so disagreement is meaningful; coarse and 2–7 day latency.

nodes.label: OpenWeatherMap free endpoints (cross-check)
nodes.rationale: Already integrated third opinion; ODbL share-alike so kept transient ≤14 days.

nodes.label: All mandi sources share the Agmarknet origin
nodes.rationale: Mandi sources add availability, not independent verification; weather sources are partially independent.

nodes.label: Name canonicalization via alias maps
nodes.rationale: Without it, spelling variants produce duplicate rows instead of reconciled ones.

nodes.label: Quality flags (nonpositive, order_violation, missing_price, outlier)
nodes.rationale: Flag, do not delete; flagged rows excluded from aggregates.

nodes.label: Reconcile by source_priority
nodes.rationale: Stops a stale Kaggle/CEDA row overwriting a live row.

nodes.label: Gaps are gaps (date spine with nulls, no interpolation)
Grid snapping to 0.1° grid_key
nodes.rationale: Matches ERA5-Land resolution; many locations share a cache entry.

nodes.label: Routing by horizon (past-archive, past-recent, today, future)
nodes.rationale: ERA5-Land lags ~5 days so newest past days come from model analysis, later reconciled.

nodes.label: Advisory contract: low confidence means hedged advice
Multi-model forecast spread (ecmwf_ifs025, gfs_seamless, icon_seamless)
nodes.rationale: Principled forecast-disagreement signal at no extra cost.

nodes.label: Same-source baselines for anomalies (ERA5-Land 2010–2024 normals)
nodes.rationale: Comparing ERA5-Land actuals against NASA POWER climatology would inject inter-dataset bias.

nodes.label: Gridded rainfall is an area estimate
v_mandi_daily view (median modal across varieties)
nodes.rationale: Median is robust; feed has no arrivals so no arrival weighting.

nodes.label: upsert_mandi_prices RPC (priority-aware upsert)
nodes.rationale: Caller must dedupe in-batch since ON CONFLICT cannot touch same row twice.

nodes.label: RLS deny-by-default security
nodes.rationale: Frontend must go through FastAPI; service role server-side only.

nodes.label: Provider error taxonomy (Timeout, HTTPError, SchemaError, QuotaError)
data.gov.in pagination trap and demo-key detector
nodes.rationale: Server may return fewer rows than limit; advance offset by records returned.

nodes.label: config/fusion.yaml (primary order, validators, tolerances, IMD rain buckets)
Agro metrics (rain_7d, rain_30d, dry_spell_days, anomalies)
nodes.rationale: Computed on read; inherit lowest confidence of their days.

nodes.label: Weather Tier B on-demand path (Open-Meteo only, capped medium)
Mandi Tier B watch list and graduation (LRU cap 300)
Crop margin calculator (DES Cost of Cultivation)
nodes.rationale: Annual survey data lags; must carry cost_year and return null when no cost data.

nodes.label: Storage estimator (hold-vs-sell)
nodes.rationale: Non-storable crops like tomato short-circuit; historical comparison, never a prediction.

nodes.label: DES Comprehensive Scheme for Cost of Cultivation
Market API (/api/market/latest, trend, search, margin, storage-estimate)
/api/context/market-weather descriptive signals
nodes.rationale: Signals are descriptive and rule-based; never phrased as predictions.

nodes.label: Scheduled jobs (ingest_mandi_daily, ingest_weather, reconcile_recent, power_validate, prune)
Resilience policy (timeouts, retries, circuit breaker, degradation ladder)
Storage budget and retention (prune)
nodes.rationale: 16k rows/day national feed × 90 days ≈ 1.4M rows exceeds 500 MB; never remove Tier A scope filter.

nodes.label: Testing and observability (fixtures, no network in CI)
Attribution and licensing (Agmarknet, CEDA, Open-Meteo, NASA POWER CC BY 4.0)

hyperedges.label: Mandi source priority chain (datagov 100 > agmarknet 80 > CEDA 50 > Kaggle 10)
